int _smatrix_insert ( smatrix_t *  mat_in,
long int  i_in,
long int  j_in,
long int  idx_in,
double  val_in 
)

Used internally only; Does not modify nvals.

This function takes the actual index into the row. This is emphasized by using idx_in instead of j_in, which would be a column index rather than an insertion point. User must call binary_search() to get the desired insertion index before calling _smatrix_insert().
